about: The runner of a simulated user (SPEC.md section 7.10, "Simulated user", #667). Each case gives a value of the config key persona_runner, and the command of one message and the record keys, or the error of the reader. <folder> is the new temporary folder of the message. A case with no value has no key persona_runner. Nookku has no built-in codex runner, so the value codex is an error. This file is hand-written.
